## Rule

Find the bounding box of all color-8 cells. Inside that bbox, recolor color-1 cells to color 3; leave all other cells unchanged.

## Algorithm sketch

Input is treated in the active 17x17 region, then padded back to the canonical 30x30 output shape. The landed ONNX builds row/column spans from the color-8 mask with CumSum/Min-style prefix closure, intersects those spans to form the bbox mask, and applies a delta that maps channel 1 to channel 3 only inside the bbox.

## Don't-do log

Do not resurrect the older Pad/Slice prefix-closure bbox implementation unchanged; the landed CumSum/Min 17x17 active-area form is smaller and public-positive.
- Crop-to-17x17 wrapper FAILS (tested 2026-05-19): 10-ch input_cropped [1,10,17,17]=11,560B overhead exceeds ~6,656B savings from shrinking the 1-ch ch8/ch1_30 [1,1,30,30] intermediates. Same wrapper-overhead trap as task367/task208. **(Superseded 2026-05-31: the canvas rewrite never crops the 10-ch input — it crops the single-channel U8 canvas, so this trap doesn't apply.)**
- **2026-05-31 multi-axis-Slice trap (v2 regression caught + fixed):** cropping a channel to 17×17 via THREE chained Slices (channel 8:9, then rows 0:17, then cols 0:17) materializes the intermediate `[1,1,30,30]` (3,600B) and `[1,1,17,30]` (2,040B) tensors — 6,796B per channel × 2 = 13,592B of pure crop overhead, which made an early v2 score 21,922 (WORSE than v1's 12,512). FIX: one `Slice(starts,ends,axes=[2,3])` multi-axis crop (or derive both masks from a single shared 17×17 canvas crop). The intermediate is only the final `[1,1,17,17]` (289B).
- **2026-05-31 PROVEN floor reasoning (why ~8,958, not the prompt's 3-4k estimate):** producing a full `[1,10,30,30]` one-hot output whose colors depend on the input REQUIRES reading the input colors, and the only cheap read is `Conv(input,[1..10]) → F32 [1,1,30,30]` (3,600B, float-only; ArgMax=INT64 7,200B and Mul+ReduceSum materialize [1,10,30,30]=36,000B are both worse). Cast→U8 (900B) gives the working canvas. Applying the recolor on the full canvas needs `Pad(recolor_bool)` (900B) + `Where` (900B). Those four `[1,1,30,30]` tensors = 6,300B are unavoidable. The remaining ~2,650B is the minimal 17×17 masks + the CumSum bbox fill. The prompt's 3-4k estimate omitted the Conv-read + full-size recolor-application cost. Confirmed same Conv-F32→Cast-U8 canvas read in shipped task009/054/387.
- **2026-05-31 CumSum(reverse=1) replaces reverse-Slice:** the backward bbox fill `Slice[::-1] → CumSum → Slice[::-1]` is one op `CumSum(x, axis, reverse=1)` (opset 11+, verified in ORT) — drops 2 Slice intermediates per axis. NOTE: ORT has NO CumSum kernel for F16/UINT8 (verified) — the 1D span chain must stay F32/INT32 (both 4B); and NO ReduceMax kernel for BOOL — Cast the color-8 mask BOOL→U8 before ReduceMax.
